context:
Goal: each row in the Sync panel says plainly what it shows, on the web and the phone.
Problem: item 16b says to change the labels back to LEDGER, PHOTOS and KEY. The rows today show server status, last sync time and the sync key. A plain rename puts PHOTOS over a sync time that has nothing to do with photos.
Based on: the web's Sync rows are Server, Last sync and Sync key (read, src/app.jsx partGrid).
Based on: your ruling of 2026-10-27 12:25 CDT, in record sync-particulars-ruled-values (ruling).
Based on: the web already tracks photo sync state (read: photoSync, photoUsage, lostPhotos).
Departs from: b and c change what the web's Sync rows show today.
Meanwhile: the sync-labels lane waits. Step 5 goes on.
home: record sync-particulars-ruled-values, which restyle rewrites in step 10 with option b

options.gain: The literal ruling, and the smallest change.
options.how: LEDGER over server status, PHOTOS over last sync, KEY over the sync key.
options.label: Rename only
options.lose: PHOTOS sits over a time, so the label is wrong.

options.gain: Every label matches its value, as the old rows did.
options.how: LEDGER shows server status and last sync, such as "Connected · 2 min ago". PHOTOS shows photo sync, such as "synced" or "3 to send". KEY shows the key.
options.label: LEDGER, PHOTOS, KEY with matching values
options.lose: A bigger lane: a new photo value on web and phone, and a screen re-check.

options.gain: No wrong label, and a small change.
options.how: Keep today's three rows, with uppercase labels.
options.label: SERVER, LAST SYNC, KEY

title: The Sync panel's LEDGER, PHOTOS and KEY labels: which value goes under each?
why: It's the only option where every label tells the truth and still follows 16b.
